title: The Interrupting Owl: How Good Listeners Win Hearts!

lines.text: Ollie the young owl knew fascinating facts about stars, acorns, and forest geography!
lines.caps: Ollie the young owl knew fascinating facts about stars, acorns, and forest *GEOGRAPHY!

lines.text: Whenever a friend began telling a story, Ollie hooted right over them to share his thoughts!
lines.caps: Whenever a friend began telling a story, Ollie hooted right over them to share *HIS | *THOUGHTS!

lines.text: Yesterday I found a cool pebble—began mouse! WELL I FOUND A METEORITE! shouted Ollie!
lines.caps: Yesterday I found a cool pebble—began mouse! WELL I FOUND A *METEORITE! | shouted *OLLIE!

lines.text: Soon, his animal friends felt unheard and stopped inviting Ollie to their fireside chats!
lines.caps: Soon, his animal friends felt unheard and stopped inviting Ollie to their *FIRESIDE | *CHATS!

lines.text: Wise Grandpa Owl told him, You have two big ears and only one beak for a very good reason!
lines.caps: Wise Grandpa Owl told him, You have two big ears and only one beak for a very *GOOD | *REASON!

lines.text: Listening carefully lets you discover amazing things you never would have known on your own!
lines.caps: Listening carefully lets you discover amazing things you never would have known on *YOUR | *OWN!

lines.text: At the next campfire, Ollie waited patiently, nodding along as mouse finished her story!
lines.caps: At the next campfire, Ollie waited patiently, nodding along as mouse finished *HER | *STORY!

lines.text: Being a great listener makes people feel valued and turns casual buddies into best friends!
lines.caps: Being a great listener makes people feel valued and turns casual buddies into *BEST | *FRIENDS!

lines.text: Listen with your heart and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
